notes: Setting up in your Sheet: Google only lets a copy publish itself if it’s linked to a Google Cloud project you manage, which a new copy isn’t. So the SETUP window now shows you how to publish once with Google’s own Deploy button (about a minute), spots it by itself and carries on. No Apps Script API switch to find.

Two fewer Google permissions: HouseRunner no longer asks to “create and update Apps Script projects and deployments”. Nine in all. The privacy notice is updated to match – you’ll be asked to accept it once more.
